items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 23, 2003 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: And when Wayne Wright got up to play there was something wrong with his amplifier so he says, “I’ll play without the amplifier.” He sounded marvelous.

ctx.x: Hmm. You kind of long for some of that to come back.

Yeah. And it’s very funny, about three weeks ago I went out to Long Island to listen to a guitar get together. And I saw Billy Bauer and Don Arnone, a lot of the old timers that I used to work with in the studios. And when Wayne Wright got up to play there was something wrong with his amplifier so he says, “I’ll play without the amplifier.” He sounded marvelous. © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-
